summary: Bare build() watches only paths that exist at build time; a later permissions/ manifest, tauri.windows.conf.json or icon change is ignored until a forced rebuild
evidence: acl.rs:304-310 rerun-if-changed=permissions only if it exists; parse.rs:183-186 platform config only if it exists; lib.rs:810-876 icon without rerun line
failure_scenario: Developer adds permissions/default.toml for app commands (the FND-0030 fix): cached OUT_DIR keeps has_app_manifest=false until cargo clean. Same for platform config overrides and icon replacement. Fix belongs in build.rs.
